title: One Sunday that redrew the top of two leagues
summary: One afternoon reset the shape of two title races. Manchester City won 3-0 at Anfield after Ryan Gravenberch's second booking left Liverpool with ten men for the closing half-hour; Haaland, Doku and Cherki scored in a thirteen-minute burst. In Germany, ten-man Freiburg beat Schalke 2-1 through a late Keisuke Goto goal to go top on goal difference, after Bayern's earlier stumble in the matchday. Crystal Palace's 3-1 win over Nottingham Forest was the weekend's other outlier; in Italy, Juventus needed a late Kolo Muani header to draw 1-1 at Cagliari.
